findings.note: The discovered Registry is parsed into registry_document, but registry_digest is computed by a separate dependency invocation that independently rediscovers and rereads the Registry. A Registry change between steps 5 and 6 can therefore make evaluations use the old document while context_binding binds the new document; the later recheck compares against the new digest and can pass. This violates the fixed-snapshot and generation-consistency requirements.

Zero-exit evaluator output validation checks only that result is boolean, evidence is an array, and its members are objects. Evidence nodes missing required operator/path/outcome fields or containing malformed nested children are accepted, later becoming output-schema-validation-failed instead of the required dependency-output-malformed classification.

When an evaluation WARN is collected before a later predicate subprocess failure, the implementation forwards severity:warn entries but adds only the later failure's block diagnostic. This leaves dsl-warn-on-matched-capability present with warn entries and no block summary, directly contradicting REQ-004/AC-056. Additionally, if failure occurs later within the same capability, completed earlier evaluations for that capability are lost because the capability entry is appended only after its entire evaluation finishes.
